name: Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited
summary: Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited operates as an owner and operator of luxury hotels in India. The company operates three hotels in Hyderabad, namely Taj Krishna; Taj Deccan; and Vivanta Begumpet; Taj Club House, and Taj Chandigarh, and also operates Taj Santacruz. The company provides accommodation services, including guest rooms and suites at its hotel properties. It also offers food and beverage services through multi-cuisine restaurants, specialty dining venues, and bars, including Encounters and Golden Dragon. In addition, the company provides banquet and event services, including banquet halls and conference room facilities for corporate events, social functions, and conferences. Furth…
